shellCommands.command: pwd && git status --short && git log --oneline | head -5 && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100
for f in package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; echo; done
npm ci 2>&1 | tail -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/ | head; grep -rl "useToaster" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && cat index.d.ts; cat hooks/useToaster.d.ts; ls; cat types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; cat ToasterComponent.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat ToasterProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cat ../../../../../uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toaster.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80

cat hooks/useToaster.js; echo ---; cat Provider/ToasterProvider.d.ts; echo ---; cat ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.d.ts; echo ---; cat constants.js | head -30; echo ---; cat withToaster.js | head -30; echo; echo ---; cat Provider/*.js | head -60

cat ToasterComponent/ToasterComponent.js | head -60; echo ---; grep -rn "autoHiding" --include=*.js . | grep -v map | head -20; echo ---; cat Toaster.js | head -60; echo; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json

grep -n "DEFAULT_TIMEOUT" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/Toast/Toast.js | head -3; grep -rn "DEFAULT_TIMEOUT =" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster/ | grep -v map; grep -n "toaster" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n "Toaster\|Button" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts | head
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx vite build 2>&1 | tail -8

(which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1; ls /usr/lib/node_modules 2>/dev/null) ; (npx vite --port 5173 --strictPort > /tmp/vite.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s localhost:5173 | head -5
mkdir -p /tmp/e2e && cd /tmp/e2e && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright@1 >/dev/null 2>&1 && timeout 300 npx playwright install --with-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -3
cd /tmp/e2e && timeout 300 npx playwright install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null

cat > /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mjs <<'EOF'
export default { test: { environment: 'jsdom', include: ['src/__smoke__.test.tsx'], root: '/home/sandbox/workspace' } };
EOF
timeout 200 npx vitest run --config /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mjs 2>&1 | tail -40

cat > /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mjs <<'EOF'
export default { test: { environment: 'jsdom', include: ['src/__smoke__.test.tsx'], root: '/home/sandbox/workspace', css: true, server: { deps: { inline: [/@gravity-ui/] } } } };
EOF
timeout 200 npx vitest run --config /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -40
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Toaster && sed -n 1,140p Toast/Toast.js; echo ---; cat ToastList/ToastList.js | head -80
timeout 200 npx vitest run --config /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mjs 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | grep -E "toasts still|✓|×|FAIL|Tests |AssertionError|Expected|Received" | head -30
timeout 200 npx vitest run --config /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mjs 2>&1 | grep -A4 "toasts still" | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | head -8

rm -f src/__smoke__.test.tsx && rm -rf dist && rm -f /tmp/vitest.smoke.config.mjs && for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do if grep -q "vite" $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null; then kill $(basename $p) 2>/dev/null && echo "killed $(basename $p)"; fi; done; git status --short; git diff --stat

(curl -s -m 2 localhost:5173 >/dev/null && echo "dev server still up" || echo "dev server stopped"); npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn"; echo "tsc exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; cat src/App.tsx | head -5

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *vite*) echo "$(basename $p): $c"; kill $(basename $p) 2>/dev/null;; esac; done; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 localhost:5173 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"
kill 5389 5375 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 localhost:5173 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "dev server stopped"; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && git status --short

for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do n=$(basename $p); c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *"bin/vite"*|*"exec vite"*) echo "$n: $c"; kill -9 $n 2>/dev/null;; esac; done; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 localhost:5173 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "dev server stopped"
curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:5173; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do n=${p#/proc/}; c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in node*vite*) echo "$n: $c";; esac; done

(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep 5173; for p in /proc/[0-9]*; do n=${p#/proc/}; c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < $p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *vite*) echo "$n: ${c:0:120}";; esac; done
